en: A monochrome postcard photograph showing a steamship at sea or in a harbor, viewed from the side. The vessel has a single tall funnel with faint lettering on it and masts fore and aft. The bow on the right side bears the name "MAX." The background shows a low shoreline with industrial structures or harbor buildings. The water in the foreground is slightly choppy. There is handwriting along the bottom edge of the image and postal-cancellation marks across the upper portion.
